style.checked_requirement: Saturated social illustration; oblique orange ellipse, indigo adults/contours, pale lilac fact ledges, central title-bearing paper, square Korean title and extended English.

evidence.observation: Two adults lean toward one paper, and a third forearm lifts a botanical block beside the impression.
Adult facial features, indigo contour fields and pale carved cuts give the scene an engraved illustration character.

issues: The top head is larger and more tightly cropped than the guide's 65–75px heads.
Lower-right facts are right aligned rather than the planned x420 left alignment.

format.observation: One full-frame opaque-looking landscape poster on a lilac ground; no contact sheet or room mockup.

evidence.observation: A substantive shared table, adult readers, grasping forearm, slab and printed branch establish the event's two connected activities.
The title-bearing sheet also carries the plant impression; both readers look towards this shared output rather than separate books.

issues: The pale beige striated slab edges suggest wood instead of clearly identifiable rubber.
Carved face and impression share a botanical motif, but leaf/berry details are not a clear feature-for-feature match.

hangul.location: central title and four fact groups
hangul.observation: Square serif title strokes are intact; sans facts have distinguishable counters and visible word gaps. No ambiguous Hangul glyph was observed. The title soft-wraps after the first word.

information_relationship.location: upper-left attendance block and bottom ledges
information_relationship.observation: Date, time, venue and entry form a single four-row block. Fee and application are paired below left; apron and welcome are paired below right. All eleven entries are readable at 720px width.

function_contact.applicability: No URL, QR, contact or interactive function was requested.
function_contact.observation: No invented contact details were observed.

material_edge_finish.observation: The grasping hand, lifted block edge and shadow separate clearly from the sheet. The block's beige striped thickness looks woodlike. The cream paper contains faint speckles and the outer lilac ground is softly mottled.

located_observations.observation: The orange ellipse and shared page dominate; cropped top reader and right reader flank the page.
The title is only on the shared paper; impression sits to its right without crossing letters.
The time uses two clear colons and a longer horizontal range dash with compact optical spacing.

residuals: The slab's beige striated side walls visually suggest wood more than rubber; this will motivate a bounded material/transfer repair.
The block and print carry similar branches, but individual cut features are not an exact visible match.
The top reader's head is larger and hair is clipped at the frame compared with the assigned guide.
Lower-right copy is right aligned instead of the planned left alignment.
Faint paper speckles and ground mottling remain despite the cleaner flat-material direction.
next_action: One bounded repair to clarify matte rubber and the matching transferred nonletter impression, preserving the readable copy and shared-table relationships.
